diffScopedChecks: MAX_PROMPT_RETIRES is read by code only inside recordPromptFailure (worker-admission.ts 474 verdict, 479 log line); every other occurrence is a comment.
retirePromptFailedClaim has exactly one caller: the retireDeadClaim dep wiring in the ProcessManager constructor (processes.ts 435-436).

retirePromptFailedClaim: deriveRetryContext, then await markWorkerDeadLocked (the stop), then on `died` removeFromQueue, then publishWorkerDied unless isTreeGone — removeFromQueue runs after the stop (processes.ts 1326-1340).
recordPromptFailure writes promptRetires/promptFailures only after retireDeadClaim resolved, so a StopFailed leaves locator and both counters untouched (worker-admission.ts 475-477).

Both recordPromptFailure call sites (queueUnstartedPrompt 512; promoteQueuedWorker catch 799) run outside withAdmissionLock and inside the role lock only, so removeFromQueue's withAdmissionLock cannot deadlock.
launchWorker's freshClaim spreads `...(claim?.promptRetires ? { promptRetires: claim.promptRetires } : {})` beside launchFailures (processes.ts 3322).
queueUnstartedPrompt publishes worker-queued only when the verdict is not `died` (worker-admission.ts 514-516).
